claim_text: North corridor water pad reported active
sampling_or_trigger: on state change plus five-minute health pulse
gap_detection: missing two pulses marks path stale
transport_semantics: MQTT application message with native topic and packet metadata
queue_or_overflow: broker queue and retained flag recorded
decision_rule: route inspection packet but do not declare flood or actuate valve
degradation_rule: if heartbeat stale or identity conflicts mark indeterminate and call manager
evidence_boundary: Direct observation of one pad only; no depth source extent cause or real facility state

gap_detection: no path inventory for building-wide extent
decision_rule: prohibit flood declaration and physical shutoff from available telemetry
degradation_rule: route qualified inspection and specialist escalation
evidence_boundary: Unknown teaching claim; one active pad cannot establish building-wide flooding

claim_text: Water pad observation path health is current
expected_continuity: two expected pulses per ten minutes
transport_semantics: MQTT QoS recorded without promoting delivery to sensor fitness
common_mode_dependency: gateway and water pad share site power
degradation_rule: if pulse late mark stale not dry
evidence_boundary: Heartbeat supports path currency only; it does not prove water state or calibration

claim_text: North corridor humidity increased during alert window
gap_detection: gap when no sample covers an expected minute
common_mode_dependency: shared controller network and building power
degradation_rule: if input gap or unit conflict block derived trend
evidence_boundary: Deterministic fictional trend; not direct water observation or causal proof

claim_text: Outbound gate closed-limit point is active
degradation_rule: if snapshot late or switch conflict mark indeterminate
evidence_boundary: Limit switch does not establish lane clearance latch security or customer access outcome

population_denominator: all objects and people in lane
degradation_rule: require qualified local observation under site procedure
evidence_boundary: Deliberate unknown; no camera or loop evidence is invented

claim_text: Maximum observed temperature at corridor probes for interval
change_filter: drop impossible values and preserve rejection count
expected_continuity: complete one-minute grid per active probe
transport_semantics: metrics stream with explicit gauge semantics
decision_rule: route inspection if threshold and completeness tests pass
degradation_rule: if any active probe gap then label partial and prohibit building-wide claim
evidence_boundary: Derived maximum covers only three probe locations and the named interval

claim_text: Every unit remained within temperature range
degradation_rule: retain corridor result and route scoped inspection
evidence_boundary: Corridor probes cannot establish each unit temperature or customer outcome

decision_rule: do not declare forced entry from uncertain contact
degradation_rule: request local inspection and preserve native quality
evidence_boundary: Contact state does not establish cause authorization person identity or intrusion

claim_text: Published office hours match approved governing record
transport_semantics: HTTPS retrieval plus governed record read
decision_rule: permit match claim for exact records and check time
degradation_rule: if either source stale or unavailable mark unverified
evidence_boundary: Record equality does not prove staffing facility access or legal availability

degradation_rule: do not infer image quality view coverage recording or incident absence
evidence_boundary: No image content or person data included; connected is not visual coverage

decision_rule: route qualified review but no automated electrical conclusion
degradation_rule: if inspection expired or sequence gap mark inadmissible
evidence_boundary: Measurement is fictional and not electrical safety advice or facility condition evidence

claim_text: No alarm event occurred in the complete overnight window
population_denominator: all active expected points in partition
sampling_or_trigger: all events plus one-minute path health
expected_continuity: complete interval with health and sequence
gap_detection: inventory plus sequence plus path-health completeness
common_mode_dependency: same controller makes common-mode failure possible
decision_rule: permit no-recorded-event claim only when completeness passes
degradation_rule: if any point inventory gap health gap or overflow mark unknown
evidence_boundary: No-recorded-event is not proof no physical security condition existed

claim_text: Count of recorded after-hours access grants
population_denominator: all active governed readers in partition
native_quality: source accepted with one late reader
decision_rule: withhold final count while one reader is late
degradation_rule: rerun after reader deadline or publish bounded partial with denominator
evidence_boundary: Fictional count process; not person identity occupancy crime or customer-behavior evidence

claim_text: Qualified manager inspected pad area under procedure
change_filter: procedure version requires timestamp and limitations
degradation_rule: if procedure incomplete or scope unclear retain unknown extent
evidence_boundary: Human declaration is bounded by procedure view and time; not independent certification

claim_text: Individual unit interiors are intentionally unobserved
decision_rule: prohibit attempts to infer interior activity from unrelated signals
degradation_rule: route legitimate needs through approved policy and qualified review
evidence_boundary: Intentional privacy boundary; absence of collection is not a defect or proof of interior state
